movie_title: C-SPAN Cities Tour - Albany: Lily of the Mohawks
introduction: Author Jack Casey tells the story of Kateri Tekakwitha, a Mohawk woman born in present-day New York
lead_intro: Discover the intriguing story of Lily of the Mohawks, also known as Catherine, and her remarkable journey to sainthood.

quiz.question: What was the original name of Lily of the Mohawks before she was baptized?
quiz.explanation: Lily of the Mohawks was originally named Techawith before being baptized by the Jesuits.

quiz.question: In which year did Lily of the Mohawks pass away?
quiz.explanation: Lily of the Mohawks passed away in the year 1680 at the age of 24.

quiz.question: What miraculous event prompted the pope to canonize Lily of the Mohawks?
choices: Curing of a young Native American boy afflicted with a flesheating bacteria
Healing a breach birth during childbirth
Rediscovery of her manuscripts in the 1840s
quiz.answer: Curing of a young Native American boy afflicted with a flesheating bacteria
quiz.explanation: The miraculous cure of a young Native American boy named Jake Fininkbonner led to the canonization of Lily of the Mohawks.

quiz.question: What significant event led to the cessation of miracles attributed to Lily of the Mohawks?
quiz.explanation: The miracles attributed to Lily of the Mohawks ceased around 1760 when the English took over Canada from the French.

quiz.question: What role did Father Claude Shashhatier play in Lily of the Mohawks' spiritual journey?
choices: He drew out her spirituality and helped heal his own doubts
He was a priest at St. Francis Xavier mission
He authored a novel about her life
quiz.answer: He drew out her spirituality and helped heal his own doubts
quiz.explanation: Father Claude Shashhatier recognized and drew out the spirituality of Lily of the Mohawks, which in turn helped heal his own doubts.
